question: Among the top 3 youngest drivers in Formula 1 history, find the one who has the most race wins (i.e., finished in position 1) in races where the constructor earned more than 100 points in the same race. Return the driver's forename and surname.

prediction.sql:
WITH Youngest AS (
  SELECT XCL_034 AS driverId, XCL_038 AS forename, XCL_039 AS surname
  FROM drivers
  ORDER BY XCL_040 ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
Wins AS (
  SELECT y.driverId, y.forename, y.surname, COUNT(*) AS win_count
  FROM Youngest y
  JOIN results r ON r.XCL_075 = y.driverId
  JOIN constructorResults cr ON cr.XCL_011 = r.XCL_074 AND cr.XCL_012 = r.XCL_076
  WHERE r.XCL_079 = 1 AND cr.XCL_013 > 100
  GROUP BY y.driverId, y.forename, y.surname
)
SELECT forename, surname
FROM Wins
ORDER BY win_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH Youngest AS (
  SELECT XCL_034 AS driverId, XCL_038 AS forename, XCL_039 AS surname
  FROM drivers
  ORDER BY XCL_040 ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
Wins AS (
  SELECT y.driverId, y.forename, y.surname, COUNT(*) AS win_count
  FROM Youngest y
  JOIN results r ON r.XCL_075 = y.driverId
  JOIN constructorResults cr ON cr.XCL_011 = r.XCL_074 AND cr.XCL_012 = r.XCL_076
  WHERE r.XCL_079 = 1 AND cr.XCL_013 > 100
  GROUP BY y.driverId, y.forename, y.surname
)
SELECT forename, surname
FROM Wins
ORDER BY win_count DESC
LIMIT 1
